content.title: About
content.content: All‑purpose wheat flour, enriched with vitamins and minerals, and free from bleaching agents. Ideal for bread, cakes, cookies, and a wide range of baked goods.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Enriched flour contains iron, thiamine, riboflavin and folic acid.
Unbleached flour retains a natural creamy‑off‑white color and wheat aroma.
Higher protein content improves dough structure and elasticity.
Wheat flour is a staple carbohydrate source in many cultures.
There are numerous wheat varieties that affect flour color and performance.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Enrichment adds thiamine, riboflavin and niacin, supporting energy metabolism.

items.title: Source of iron
items.content: Iron helps maintain normal hemoglobin levels.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Fiber from the whole grain components promotes healthy bowel function.

items.title: Contains folic acid
items.content: Folic acid is essential for DNA synthesis and especially important during pregnancy.

items.title: Energy provider
items.content: Flour supplies quick‑release carbohydrates needed for physical activity.

items.title: Wheat allergy
items.content: People with celiac disease or wheat allergy may experience adverse reactions.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Large portions can cause rapid blood‑sugar spikes.

items.title: Nutrient loss over time
items.content: Vitamins may degrade if flour is stored for long periods under poor conditions.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Use flour for bread, rolls, cakes, cookies, pancakes, pizza dough and many other recipes. It can be blended with other flours to modify texture. Sift before use for best results.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in an airtight container in a cool, dry place. For extended storage, refrigerate or freeze to prevent fat oxidation.
